subtitle: Pixel-art pocket pets

apps.name: Gotchi Galaxy
apps.subtitle: A pocket pet for your phone
apps.localizedDescription: A pixel-art pocket pet you raise, breed and take to far-away planets.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Ten new animals: a mouse, a guinea pig and a parrot on Ribbon Reef, a red panda, an owl, a badger, a chipmunk, a beaver and a wolf pup in Sporewood, and a tiger cub on Fernos.
- New furniture is picked up as soon as you place it, so you choose where it stands.

- Six farm friends moved to Meadowvale: a piglet, a calf, a duckling, a chick, a goat kid and a pony.
- Every piece of furniture is now built from 3D shapes, so legs, tops and shelves always line up.
- Move your furniture anywhere on the floor: Room Decor, Furniture, pick a piece, Move. Your pets walk around it.

- Every pet got a glow-up: all 21 species redrawn as little animals, each with a look of its own.
- Pets are born dressed to suit their personality, in colours of their own.
- Every species has a signature move it shows off when the mood is right.
- Bitbot is now Digby the mole, and Rexlet is now Drakelet the baby dragon.
- With pets asleep in two rooms, the lights switch the room you are in, and turning one off no longer turns another back on.

- If the game ever closes by itself, we now learn why, and nothing personal is sent.
- Long translations on the Housemates page no longer overlap.

- Eight new dresses in the wardrobe: pinafores, puff sleeves, lace hems, a blossom coat.
- Hats now sit right on every pet: none over the eyes, none floating.
- Festive hats redrawn in full detail.
- Every species' own piece is now in the wardrobe: keep it on, or take it off.
- The beanie, nightcap, earmuffs, cloud clip and scarf species are born with, redrawn.
- Bows, bells and medals show properly on every pet, babies too.
- Pets use the garden door, move smoothly and stay dry at clean-up.

- Fixed: on iPhone, the game came back at half size after switching apps.
- Follow a pet into the garden and you see it walk in.
- The Love Lab says when a new egg waits in the Lodge.

- Clothes: tops, dresses and overalls, and pets grow into their born outfit.
- Four new hats, and every wardrobe piece redrawn in finer detail.
- The house in 3D: furniture with real depth, a glass fish tank, a 3D garden.
- Focus mode gives each life stage its own little scene.
- Garden: water a whole bed at once and see when each plant can be picked.
- Letter Swap is now Word Hunt, and no letter gets lost.

- Pick your first egg: leaf, flame, splash or a rare one.
- A walk into the shop, with a cat at the counter.
- Hints in the word games when a puzzle gets tough.
- A garden hint before it opens; arrows take the focus.
- Fixed: the arrow in the garden opened a flower bed.

- A garden opens when your first pet grows up.
- Grow flowers: plant, water, pick, give, craft.
- Pets wander between rooms; care works anywhere.
- Word games in English: Letter Swap, Word Pals.
- Move your island to a new device.
- Android widget: a little scene with your pet.

- Mac: the app opens on other Macs (no more "damaged").
- Settings: pick a language from a list.
- Star Miles: tap a task to go do it.
- Android: a home-screen widget with your pet.
- Kinder Vietnamese words in a few menus.
